Be on your guard--I can bet that there's more to their stradegy than what we can see.|audio = KorbloxTempleWave-9.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 9 ([[Korblox Temple]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Fallen Necromancer''' is a summoner enemy that appears in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]], Fallen Arena [[PVP]] modes and [[The Takeover Event]]. It has high health but has a speed slightly slower than the [[Fallen Squire]]. It has an ability where it slams its staff, summoning eight [[Fallen Skeleton]]s. ==Logbook Description== "''Fallen Necromancers were priests who used to tend to the dead, ensuring peaceful passage to the afterlife. When the Queen's sacrifice destroyed the boundary between life and death, they gained the power to raise the fallen. The curse allowed them to cast dark rituals that bind souls to corpses. Now, they are protected by the very dead they once laid to rest.''" ==Appearance== The '''Fallen Necromancer''' has no legs and greyish skin. It has a silver crown that has a blue shard in the middle and silver horns. It has a tiger skull with horns on each shoulder, possibly serving as shoulder pads. It wears a grey scarf and a necklace with possibly shark teeth on it, and a blue crystal. Its arms have bluish-grey arm plates, bandages and metal. It has a grey chest-plate. It also wears a belt. It wields a grey staff with a skull at the top, and holds it over its shoulder while walking. It slams the staff to the ground and conjures purple smoke when using its ''Summon'' ability. It has a death animation where it spins while falling to the ground, dropping its staff. ==Strategy== *The '''Fallen Necromancer''' can be a threat when it first appears, as it can summon many [[Fallen Skeleton]]s if not killed quickly, creating hordes, especially in groups. **Early game towers like the [[Militant]], [[Golden Cowboy]], [[Ace Pilot]], [[Brawler]] or [[Golden Scout]] can take care of the '''Fallen Necromancer''' quite quickly. **High DPS towers like the [[Turret]], [[Minigunner]], [[Hunter]] and [[Accelerator]] can also be quite useful. ***Do note that the [[Accelerator]], if locked onto the '''Fallen Necromancer''' or other strong enemies, will ignore the [[Fallen Skeleton]]s the '''Fallen Necromancer''' summons until the targeted enemy is defeated or leaves its range. ***The [[Ranger]] may struggle against the hordes of [[Fallen Skeleton]]s the '''Fallen Necromancer''' summons due to its slow firerate. It can be set to ''Strongest'' to target and kill the '''Fallen Necromancer''' while other towers take care of the [[Fallen Skeleton]]s. **Area of effect towers, like the [[Mortar]], [[Rocketeer]] and [[Tesla]] can be quite useful as they can damage both the '''Fallen Necromancer''' and the [[Fallen Skeleton]]s it summons. *Do note that you do not earn any money from the summoned enemies. *The '''Fallen Necromancer''' and its [[Fallen Skeleton]]s move at a somewhat fast pace. You may want to use slowing towers like the [[Freezer]], [[Warden]] or [[Tesla]], though this is not necessary. **Do note that because of its [[Stun Immunity]], it is only slowed down by stuns and cannot be knocked back. Additionally, when it first spawns, it is a boss enemy, making chillness and stun slowdown the only forms of stalling that can slow it down. **Stalling towers with the ability to hit multiple enemies, such as the [[Tesla]], [[Freezer]] or [[Frost Blaster]], are particularly effective against the '''Fallen Necromancer''' as they can also stall the summoned [[Fallen Skeleton]]s without taking their attention away from the '''Fallen Necromancer'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} FallenNecromancerFloat.gif|Floating animation (2 August 2024 – Present) FallenNecromancerSummon.gif|Summon animation (2 August 2024 – Present) FallenNecromancerDeath.gif|Death animation (2 August 2024 – Present) FallenNecroStuncer.gif|Stun animation (2 August 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1CorruptedNecro.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFallenNecromancer.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} FallenFoesThumbnail.png|'''Fallen Necromancer''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} FallenNecromancerTeaser.png|'''Fallen Necromancer''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Gatling Gun Tower - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Fallen Necromancer''' on a promotional video.
